usedFor: Stripe takes the payments, and WooCommerce is the store. When “When a payment succeeds” fires in Stripe, “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce can make a coupon in your store.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: A paid customer is the best time for a thank-you or repeat-purchase coupon, and the trigger is pushed as the payment lands. The product-update templates change items, not customers.

watchOut: “Create Coupon” makes a new coupon on every run, so each successful payment gets one. “Update Product” changes the product on each “Payment Link Created”, so confirm that link belongs to it.
